summary: NutriSync AI iteration-2 regression pass after Material-3 Dashboard + Cabinet redesign and 4 new features (streak/reorder, guardrails, protocol modes, blood-test import). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass — health, root, protocol via gpt-5.4 (recovery), protocol via gemini-3.1-pro-preview (optimal zero-pill + recovery), OCR supplement label (magnesium/200mg/120 capsules extracted correctly), NEW OCR blood-test (ferritin/vit D/mag extracted with status), and bad-image error path. Frontend: every testID from the review request is present and functional — ModeSelector chips (mode-auto/travel/illness/deload) switch and re-analyze, streak-card renders, sync-reanalyze + header-sync trigger 'Protocol re-analyzed' toast, 3 chrono checkoffs toggle intake, theme-toggle in header flips theme; Cabinet stash-search filters live, all 4 filter chips work, missing-item-card (Glycine) + missing-item-buy render, stock ± steppers on seed-magnesium adjust count, delete-<id> present, stash-scan opens /scan; Trends seg-deep/seg-hrv toggle chart; Settings theme-segmented (system/light/dark), region chips, provider rows, gemini/openai key inputs + save, presets — acute_stress produces stress-banner on dashboard and start-breath-pacer NAVIGATES to /breath (previously flaky, now solid); rest_balanced produces zero-pill-card 'System Balanced' at readiness 98 OPTIMAL; /scan panel-segmented (seg-supplement/seg-bloodtest), manual add flow via input-brand/name/form/dose + save-supplement successfully adds TEST_Nordic/TEST_Omega3 to Cabinet (verified via stash search), blood-test panel renders blood-camera/blood-library. No functional regressions. The RN deprecation warnings from iteration 1 are still present (transform-origin, shadow*, pointerEvents) — cosmetic, unchanged. Also observed: console warn 'GO_BACK not handled' when save-supplement is triggered from a deep-linked /scan open — harmless dev warning only.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error: Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Should be `transformOrigin`. Still present on every screen with the ReadinessRing. Reference: likely /app/frontend/src/components/ReadinessRing.tsx (SVG transform prop).
Console warning: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. RN 0.74+ deprecation. Grep for `pointerEvents=` in /app/frontend/src and move into style objects.

Console warning: `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"`. Affects Card / FAB / ScreenHeader. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow for RN 0.76+ web compatibility.

Console warning: 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' fires when save-supplement (or scan-close) is pressed after opening /scan directly (no history). Not a runtime bug — but consider `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/stash')` in /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx to avoid the console error.

action_items: (Low priority, carry-over) Fix RN web deprecations: `transform-origin` → `transformOrigin` in ReadinessRing SVG style; replace `pointerEvents=` prop usage with `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}`; migrate `shadow*` styles to `boxShadow` on Card/FAB/ScreenHeader.
(Nit) In /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx, guard router.back() with router.canGoBack() to eliminate the GO_BACK dev warning when /scan is deep-linked.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py — LLM streaming still lacks a hard timeout wrapper (asyncio.wait_for). Emergent LLM latency is bounded in practice but a hung upstream would block the FastAPI worker.
backend/server.py — hardcoded model names ('gpt-5.4', 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview', 'gemini-3-flash-preview'); consider env-driven for easy rollback.
Cabinet uses soft delete (deletedAt); the 'removed' toast copy is fine but Undo would be nice.
protocolEngine / dashboardCards guardrails and blood-test flags are all client-side and deterministic — good separation.
